welcome.title: Welcome, tester!
welcome.body: Monster League is a walking game: catch creatures around Odense and Svendborg, beat trainers on the routes and win all eight arena badges. Each region is its own adventure. Thank you for helping us test it.
welcome.try.walk: Play while you walk as you normally would. Walking a whole route opens new areas.
welcome.try.travel: Forests, fields and lakes have more creatures, and some only live there: the field guide tells you where.
welcome.try.journal: Lost? The Journal in the menu shows your next goal.
welcome.install.ios: Add the game to your home screen: tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”. Otherwise the iPhone may forget your progress after a week away.
welcome.install.android: Add the game to your home screen: open the browser menu (⋮), then “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
welcome.export: Now and then, use Settings → Export save and keep the file. Settings → Import save brings it back.
welcome.feedback: Menu → Feedback: bugs, ideas, or anything that feels too hard or too easy. Your location is never sent.
welcome.known: Good to know: the creature drawings are placeholders, and some things will change between versions.

install.title: Install the game
install.help: Installed, the game opens full screen from your home screen, like an app.
install.ios: Tap the Share button (the square with an arrow), then "Add to Home Screen".
install.manual: Open the browser menu (⋮ or ⋯) and choose "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
install.done: The game is installed as an app.
onboarding.location.denied: The game isn't allowed to use your location.
onboarding.location.how: Check that location is turned on for your phone, and that this site may use it (the browser asks, or see the site settings next to the address). Then try again.
onboarding.location.howIos: On iPhone: Settings → Privacy & Security → Location Services: turn it on, and under Safari Websites choose "While Using the App". If Safari asked before and you said no, tap "aA" next to the address → Website Settings → Location → Allow. Then try again.
